text: What if a whole day lasted just one hour?
Then the sun would rise every hour. Breakfast, lunch, dinner and bedtime, all before your cartoon ends.
Ha! Short days mean short school!
Not so fast. To squeeze a day into one hour, Earth has to spin twenty-four times faster.
Today the equator spins at about a thousand miles per hour. Times twenty-four... twenty-four thousand miles per hour.
You see, spinning tries to fling everything outward. Gravity holds us down. At around seventeen thousand miles per hour, the fling wins.
At the equator, you'd float, and then fly right off into space. And the oceans would pile up around the middle of the planet.
Okay, okay. I'll keep the twenty-four hour day.
Good choice. So would the rest of the planet.
